public_oracle.observation: A duplicate payment notification leaves exactly one payment.
public_oracle.stimulus: Run `order submit --order-id O1`, then `order pay --order-id O1 --key K1` twice.
public_oracle.expected: Both pay stdouts are exactly `O1 paid payments 1` and exit is 0.
public_oracle.falsifier: A second payment recorded (`payments 2`), or a non-zero exit.
